#ifndef ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_KERNEL_MEM_SLAB_H_
#define ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_KERNEL_MEM_SLAB_H_

#include <zephyr/kernel_structs.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/slist.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/util.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

struct k_mem_slab {
	sys_slist_t free_list; /* LIFO of free blocks */
	size_t block_size;     /* size of each block */
	uint32_t num_blocks;   /* number of blocks */
	void *buffer;          /* buffer for the blocks */
#ifdef CONFIG_MEM_SLAB_DEBUG
	struct k_mem_slab_info info;
#endif
	struct k_spinlock lock;
	_wait_q_t wait_q;
};

/**
 * @brief Statically define and initialize a memory slab.
 *
 * The memory slab's buffer is aligned to a Kconfig-specified boundary.
 *
 * @param name Name of the memory slab.
 * @param block_size Size of the memory blocks.
 * @param num_blocks Number of memory blocks.
 * @param align Alignment of the memory slab's buffer and blocks.
 */
#define K_MEM_SLAB_DEFINE(name, block_size, num_blocks, align) \
	static const size_t _k_mem_slab_aligned_block_size_##name = ROUND_UP(block_size, align); \
	char __noinit __aligned(align) __used \
		_k_mem_slab_buf_##name[(_k_mem_slab_aligned_block_size_##name) * (num_blocks)]; \
	struct k_mem_slab name = { \
		.buffer = _k_mem_slab_buf_##name, \
		.block_size = _k_mem_slab_aligned_block_size_##name, \
		.num_blocks = (num_blocks), \
	}

/**
 * @brief Initialize a memory slab.
 *
 * @param slab Address of the memory slab.
 * @param buffer Pointer to the memory region used by the slab.
 * @param block_size Size of the memory blocks.
 * @param num_blocks Number of memory blocks.
 */
extern void k_mem_slab_init(struct k_mem_slab *slab, void *buffer,
			    size_t block_size, uint32_t num_blocks);

/**
 * @brief Allocate a memory block from a slab.
 *
 * @param slab Address of the memory slab.
 * @param mem Address of the memory block pointer.
 * @param timeout Waiting period to wait for a free memory block.
 *
 * @retval 0 on success.
 * @retval -ENOMEM if timeout occurred without a memory block becoming available.
 */
extern int k_mem_slab_alloc(struct k_mem_slab *slab, void **mem,
			    k_timeout_t timeout);

/**
 * @brief Free a memory block to a slab.
 *
 * @param slab Address of the memory slab.
 * @param mem Address of the memory block.
 */
extern void k_mem_slab_free(struct k_mem_slab *slab, void *mem);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_KERNEL_MEM_SLAB_H_ */
